view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view (XY plane) and a FRONT view (XZ plane). The world frame is defined as: X is the width (horizontal in Top/Front), Y is the depth (vertical in Top), and Z is the thickness/height (vertical in Front). The part is a flat plate extruded along Z.

features.section: Closed XY profile with straight edges, one arc, and one rectangular notch
features.placement: Base profile in XY plane. Origin (0,0) at bottom-left corner. The profile consists of: (1) Line (0,0) to (60,0); (2) Line (60,0) to (60,34); (3) Arc from (60,34) to (54,40) with center (54,34) and radius 6; (4) Line (54,40) to (40,40); (5) Line (40,40) to (40,30); (6) Line (40,30) to (20,30); (7) Line (20,30) to (20,40); (8) Line (20,40) to (0,40); (9) Line (0,40) to (0,0). Extrude along Z from 0 to 6.
features.evidence: Top view shows outline with dimensions 60 (width) and 40 (height). Notch is 20 wide x 10 deep, centered on top edge. Top-right corner is R6. Front view shows thickness 6. Note states 'Same outline through full thickness'.

features.placement: Center at (12, 15) in XY plane. Axis parallel to Z. Extends from Z=0 to Z=6.
features.evidence: Top view shows circle labeled 'Ø8 THROUGH'. Text notes specify 'Hole centre: 12 from left edge, 15 from bottom edge'.

connections: The through_hole is subtracted from the plate_body.
The notch is part of the plate_body profile boundary.
edit_rules: Changing the plate thickness (Z dimension) updates the extrusion height but preserves the XY profile.
Changing the notch width or depth updates the profile coordinates in the XY plane.
Changing the hole diameter updates the cylinder radius but preserves its center location.
Changing the hole center coordinates updates the cylinder position in XY.
